stdout:
usage: coldstart_sample.py plan [-h] --case-dir CASE_DIR --out OUT [--k K] [--nodes NODES]
                                [--ranks RANKS] [--omp OMP] [--nx NX] [--ny NY]
                                [--spinup-min SPINUP_MIN] [--state] [--namelist NAMELIST]
                                [--namelist-wps NAMELIST_WPS]
                                [--geo-from-wrfinput GEO_FROM_WRFINPUT] [--grib-dir GRIB_DIR]
                                [--ncdump NCDUMP] [--geog-path GEOG_PATH] [--forcing FORCING]
                                [--date-shift-to YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS | --analog ANALOG_JSON]
                                [--times T1,T2,...] [--real-only] [--ml-model REPORT.json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --case-dir CASE_DIR
  --out OUT
  --k K
  --nodes NODES
  --ranks RANKS
  --omp OMP
  --nx NX
  --ny NY
  --spinup-min SPINUP_MIN
  --state
  --namelist NAMELIST
  --namelist-wps NAMELIST_WPS
  --geo-from-wrfinput GEO_FROM_WRFINPUT
  --grib-dir GRIB_DIR
  --ncdump NCDUMP
  --geog-path GEOG_PATH
                        default: $WPS_GEOG or /nfs/data/wrf/WPS_GEOG/
  --forcing FORCING     pin the forcing chain to one dataset (e.g. d083002, ncei_g4) instead of
                        resolving it from the run's own start date -- used to re-run plan after
                        `fetch` falls back to a coarser-cadence source
  --date-shift-to YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS
                        R6-D: place/run windows at this analog date instead of the case's own
                        stated start (all times shifted by shift_s = analog - stated)
  --analog ANALOG_JSON  R6-D: same as --date-shift-to, but reads the analog date + quality from a
                        prior `case_rebuild.py analog` run's OUT/analog.json
  --times T1,T2,...     T1 (2026-09-24): use exactly these window starts (comma-separated YYYY-MM-
                        DD_HH:MM:SS, each already on the forcing grid) instead of characteristic-
                        point selection; reason='pinned'. --k is ignored.
  --real-only           T2 (2026-09-24): each window stops after real.exe succeeds -- no wrf.exe,
                        no cost prediction. `score` refuses a --real-only plan.
  --ml-model REPORT.json
                        K5 (2026-09-24): after each window's real.exe, apply
                        state_correction_model.py's ML state correction (--targets-from-report) to
                        the fresh wrfinput_d01 before wrf.exe runs. Default: off.
